import tkinter as tk

from bank import Account


class ATM(tk.Tk):
    """Ett fönster där användaren tar ut pengar från ett konto"""

    def __init__(self, account):
        super().__init__()
        self.account = account
        self.amount = tk.StringVar()
        self.message = tk.StringVar()
        tk.Label(self, text="Belopp:").grid(row=0, column=0)
        tk.Entry(self, textvariable=self.amount).grid(row=0, column=1)
        tk.Label(self, textvariable=self.message).grid(row=1, column=1)
        button = tk.Button(self, text="Ta ut", command=self.withdraw)
        button.grid(row=0, column=2)

    def withdraw(self):
        """Tar ut beloppet och visar hur det gick"""
        self.message.set(withdrawal(self.account, self.amount.get()))


def withdrawal(account, text):
    """Tar ut beloppet text och säger hur det gick"""
    if not text.isdecimal():
        return "Skriv beloppet med siffror."
    try:
        account.withdraw(int(text))
    except ValueError as error:
        return f"Det gick inte: {error}"
    return f"Saldo: {account.get_balance()} kr"


def main():
    window = ATM(Account("1001", "Ronja", 1000))
    window.mainloop()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
context.label: bankomat.py
